newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ADMINISTRATIVE ERROR COSTS MANAGER HIS JOB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ADMINISTRATIVE ERROR COSTS MANAGER HIS JOB.

text.p: Falkirk manager Eamonn Bannon was sacked on Friday, 24 hours after his club had been fined 25,000 pounds sterling ($41,600) for an administrative error.
Bannon allowed defender John Clark to play as a trialist in a 1-0 win over St Mirren in a Scottish first division match last month.
But under Scottish League rules, Clark was not allowed to turn out for the club he left in February for Dunfermline within a 12-month period.
The Scottish League management committee ordered the match to be replayed and hit cash-strapped Falkirk with a hefty fine.
Club chairman George Fulston announced Bannon's dismissal after a hurriedly called board meeting on Friday.
